reader_summary.headline: Jeffrey Solomon is the President of publicly listed Cowen Group (TK: COWN).
reader_summary.overview: Jeffrey Solomon is the President of publicly listed Cowen Group (TK: COWN), a financial services company focused on supporting and providing active management to the marketplace. After graduating from the University of Pennsylvania in 1988, Jeff deferred an acting career with a brief respite on Wall Street. In 1994, he joined Peter Cohen, then the former head of investment bank Shearson Lehman Brothers, to form money management firm Ramius Advisors.

key_points.text: After graduating from the University of Pennsylvania in 1988, Jeff deferred an acting career with a brief respite on Wall Street.
Ramius grew to become one of the largest hedge funds in the world, and in 2009 merged with boutique investment bank Cowen Group.
Following the merger, Jeff switched over to the investment bank side of the business and today serves as its Chief Executive Officer.
